about_the_game:
The Kingdom of Choices

Welcome, to the kingdom of kings! In "The Kingdom of Choices," players embark on an adventure set in the 1200s as the king of the non-existent Kingdom of Aquila. Players face various challenges in the kingdom and must manage their kingdom and shape its future.

As their characters enter the throne room, they must make challenging decisions affecting various factors, including politics, military, economy, health, religion, and the people. The choices they make determine the fate of the kingdom, and the consequences of each choice can be profound. For example, if the economy declines significantly, the country can become impoverished and face the threat of a coup.

Players can earn special cards, such as wild cards, when they rule their kingdom for extended periods. These cards can aid the player in difficult times and aid their survival.

The game always offers certain choices, and these choices lead players to various stories and endings. This rogue-lite gameplay, with multiple stories and endings, always offers players a new experience.

Players win the game if they reach an ending without dying, but the game restarts from the beginning if they die. However, with each death, players gain experience and become stronger.

The game offers players different adventures alongside the main story, with side stories. Players who want to experience different endings within the same story can repeat the same story over and over again to experience all the endings.

Start ruling your kingdom and make bold decisions on your path to becoming king!
